final_response: Done. I've replied to the customer email apologizing for the login failures and the disruption to their work, and assured them that the issue is being treated as a priority.

args.body:
Dear Customer,

Thank you for bringing this issue to our attention. I sincerely apologize for the login failures you and your account team are experiencing, and I understand how disruptive this is to your customer work.

We are treating this as a priority and are actively investigating the root cause of the login issues. Our team is working to resolve this as quickly as possible.

I will follow up with you shortly with an update on the status of the resolution. Please don't hesitate to reach out if you have any additional questions or concerns in the meantime.

Again, I apologize for the inconvenience and appreciate your patience.

Best regards
